result.question: Quais procedimentos, ordenados por volume decrescente, cobrem até 80% do total de atendimentos realizados?
result.gold_sql: SELECT nome_proc FROM (SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS nome_proc, COUNT(*) AS total_procedimentos, ROUND(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_acumulado FROM internacao_procedimento a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC") sub WHERE pct_acumulado <= 80 ORDER BY total_procedimentos DESC;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_atendimentos AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacao_procedimento ip ), procedimentos_volume AS ( SELECT p."NOME_PROC", COUNT(*) AS volume FROM internacao_procedimento ip JOIN procedimentos p ON ip."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ), procedimentos_acumulados AS ( SELECT "NOME_PROC", volume, SUM(volume) OVER (ORDER BY volume DESC) AS volume_acumulado, (SUM(volume) OVER (ORDER BY volume DESC) * 100.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_atendimentos)) AS percentual_acumulado FROM procedimentos_volume ) SELECT "NOME_PROC" FROM procedimentos_acumulados WHERE percentual_acumulado <= 80 ORDER BY percentual_acumulado;
